notes: The `לוֹ` of 'she shall be his wife' is read under rule 40 as in DEU.22.19, with the preposition unrepresented and 'his' on the suffix; rule 49's genitive fusion is the live alternative and is recorded here rather than adopted.
`תַּחַת אֲשֶׁר` is fused to one 'because' under rule 30, headed on the governing first morpheme per rule 23.
The italic 'shekels' is added under rule 33 while the written kesef holds 'of silver'.
